note: Explicit {{Cameo}} markers only (Marvel Database, DC Database, Godzilla wiki). Prose mentions on other wikis are not used.

wikis.name: Marvel Database
wikis.marker: Structured: {{Cameo|[[Character]]}} wrapper (or trailing {{Cameo}}) on entries in the Appearances lists of the "Marvel Database:Film Template"; the list mixes characters with organisations/items. Also prose in Cast/Notes/Trivia fields.

wikis.name: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki
wikis.marker: No cameo marker. Cast section has an "===Uncredited===" subsection (uncredited, not cameo) plus <small>(photo)</small>/(footage)/(voice) qualifiers; cameos appear only as prose on the "<Title>/Trivia" subpage.

wikis.name: DC Database
wikis.marker: Structured: trailing {{Cameo}} template (renders "(Cameo)") on Appearances entries of the "DC Database:Movie Template" pages, named "<Title> (Movie)" / "(TV Series)". Character-level, no actor. Cast field has a '''Uncredited:''' sub-list.

wikis.name: DC Extended Universe Wiki
wikis.marker: No cameo marker; cast uses <small>(... uncredited)</small> qualifiers and Category:Uncredited actors. "Cameo" only in prose/trivia. (dceu.fandom.com 301-redirects here.)

wikis.name: Wookieepedia
wikis.marker: No cameo template. {{C|...}} is a generic comment template; cast uses {{C|uncredited}} and the infobox has |uncreditedcast=. "Cameo" appears only in Behind-the-scenes prose.

wikis.name: Memory Alpha
wikis.marker: No cameo marker. Film/series pages have "=== Uncredited === / ==== Performers ====" lists (mostly extras). "Cameo" appears in background-information prose.

wikis.name: Gojipedia (godzilla.fandom.com)
wikis.marker: Informal: "(Cameo)" or <small>(cameo; ...)</small> after entries in Appearances/Monsters lists; "(..., uncredited)" in cast tables; prose in Trivia.

wikis.name: Wiki of Westeros
wikis.marker: None found on the series pages checked (House of the Dragon etc.); per-episode pages not fetched.

wikis.name: A Wheel of Time Wiki
wikis.marker: None found; cast uses plain "Uncredited as [[Character]]".
